name: walk_pointer_chain_recursive
description: Follows a chain of linked records, recursing on the second field of each record and then moving to the record its first field points to, until the link is zero. Each record is also passed to a second routine along with a constant.

name: parse_signed_decimal
description: Reads an optional leading plus or minus sign and then accumulates decimal digits from a null-terminated string into a 32-bit integer, negating the result for a minus sign.

name: call_library_jump_vector_198
description: Calls one Amiga library function through a jump vector at offset minus 198 from the library base held in a global, with no arguments and no result.

name: call_library_jump_vector_210
description: Calls one Amiga library function through a jump vector at offset minus 210 from the library base held in a global, with no arguments and no result.

name: call_library_jump_vector_294
description: Calls one Amiga library function through a jump vector at offset minus 294 from the library base held in a global, with no arguments and no result.

name: call_library_jump_vector_414
description: Calls one Amiga library function through a jump vector at offset minus 414 from the library base held in a global, with no arguments and no result.

name: call_library_jump_vector_552
description: Calls one Amiga library function through a jump vector at offset minus 552 from the library base held in a global, with no arguments and no result.

name: call_library_jump_vector_78
description: Calls one function through a jump vector at offset minus 78 from a different library base held in a global, with no arguments and no result.

name: call_library_jump_vector_90
description: Calls one function through a jump vector at offset minus 90 from a different library base held in a global, with no arguments and no result.

name: call_library_jump_vector_96
description: Calls one function through a jump vector at offset minus 96 from a different library base held in a global, with no arguments and no result.

name: divide_32_bit_with_remainder
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor and returns the quotient and remainder together. Divisors above 16 bits use a 16-step shift-and-subtract loop, while smaller divisors use 16-bit divide and remainder steps.

name: multiply_32_bit_integers
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values by summing 16-bit partial products, returning the low 32 bits of the product in the first result word. The second result word is the second operand with its two 16-bit halves swapped.

name: negate_on_flag
description: Calls another routine, returns its primary result, and negates that result when the secondary result register is non-zero.

name: validate_disk_bitmap_blocks
description: Entry routine of the disk validator that formats a disk number into a status text, then scans bitmap words over a block range, testing individual bits against stored block flags and counting mismatches. It makes many calls through a jump table and library vector.

name: copy_memory_and_dispatch
description: Program entry that calls a helper through a global pointer and then makes an indirect call through a jump table whose targets could not be recovered. The file uses the Amiga memory copy library call exec.CopyMem.

name: initialize_blitter_state
description: Program entry that runs a short countdown loop of library-vector calls, clears a result word, and if a value found through a linked pointer matches a fixed constant, saves it, writes a global and clears that global. It returns its input registers unchanged.

name: decrement_until_minus_one
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in a loop until it reaches minus one, then returns. It is called by find_max_and_prepare_buffer.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The bytes at this entry do not decode to valid instructions, so there is no real routine. The decompiler stopped at undecodable data.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The bytes at this entry do not decode to valid instructions, so there is no real routine. The decompiler stopped at undecodable data.

name: initialize_cpu_state
description: Program entry that runs a short countdown loop of library-vector calls, clears a result word, and if a value found through a linked pointer matches a fixed constant, saves it, writes a global and clears that global. It returns its input registers unchanged.

name: decrement_until_minus_one
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in a loop until it reaches minus one, then returns. It is one of the routines called by find_max_and_prepare_buffer.

name: initialize_game_state
description: Program entry that calls a helper and then runs a short countdown loop of library-vector calls, clears a result word, and if a value found through a linked pointer matches a fixed constant, saves it, writes a global and clears that global. The file uses the Amiga library call exec.FreeMem.

name: decrement_until_minus_one
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in a loop until it reaches minus one, then returns. It is one of the routines called by find_max_and_prepare_buffer.

name: decode_bitstream_into_buffer
description: Decoding loop that repeatedly reads values through a function pointer, tests individual bits of each value, and adds a second value into memory at a running offset. It clears the instruction cache at the start, and it is entered from outside the static flow of the file.

name: copy_bytes_backward_counted
description: Copies bytes from a source to a destination while moving both pointers backward, decrementing a count until it reaches zero. It is entered from outside the static flow of the file.

name: copy_bytes_backward_flagged
description: Copies bytes backward from a source to a destination under a count, and checks a flag byte that can send the copy into a separate branch. It is called by two other routines.

name: write_bytes_in_quads_backward
description: Writes groups of four bytes backward into memory from a source pointer, merging the leading byte with a fixed bit mask. It loops until a stacked counter reaches zero and is called by no more than one routine.

name: initialize_install_state
description: Program entry in the installer that runs a short countdown loop of library-vector calls, clears a result word, and if a value found through a linked pointer matches a fixed constant, saves it, writes a global and clears that global. It uses the Amiga library call exec.FreeMem.

name: decrement_until_minus_one
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in a loop until it reaches minus one, then returns. It is one of the routines called by find_max_and_prepare_buffer.

name: decode_bitstream_into_buffer
description: Decoding loop that repeatedly reads values through a function pointer, tests individual bits of each value, and adds a second value into memory at a running offset. It clears the instruction cache at the start, and it is entered from outside the static flow of the file.

name: copy_bytes_backward_counted
description: Copies bytes from a source to a destination while moving both pointers backward, decrementing a count until it reaches zero. It is entered from outside the static flow of the file.

name: copy_bytes_backward_flagged
description: Copies bytes backward from a source to a destination under a count, and checks a flag byte that can send the copy into a separate branch. It is called by two other routines.

name: write_bytes_in_quads_backward
description: Writes groups of four bytes backward into memory from a source pointer, merging the leading byte with a fixed bit mask. It loops until a stacked counter reaches zero and is called by no more than one routine.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The bytes at this entry do not decode to a valid instruction, so there is no real routine. The decompiler stopped at undecodable data.

name: call_library_vector_222
description: Calls one Amiga library function through a jump vector at offset minus 222 and returns. The decompiled body was unavailable, so this description rests only on the library call and the instruction count.

name: guard_task_state_with_forbid
description: Calls the Amiga library functions that forbid and permit task switching, looks up the current task, and frees memory, branching on a global state value. It sets or clears a global resource depending on that state.

name: allocate_memory_block_checked
description: Allocates memory through the Amiga system and then calls further library functions to check the allocation. On a failed step it releases the partial result, and it returns zero on the normal path.

name: query_library_field_when_ready
description: Calls one library function and, if it returns non-zero, calls a second function with the same argument. When both succeed it reads a field from the global base structure and returns it.

name: dispatch_library_handle_entry
description: Obtains a handle from a library function and, if the handle is zero, releases the result and returns minus one. Otherwise it calls the routine stored at a table entry for that handle and then calls another library function.

name: store_handle_and_release
description: Calls one library function, and if it returns a non-zero handle, stores it in a global and runs three further routines. It then calls a second library function with the same argument.

name: run_library_session_by_status
description: Calls a library function to obtain a handle and, if it is non-zero, runs six helper routines plus one more for status codes 2 or 3, then calls a second library function with the handle. The file contains a text reference to an error message.

name: loop_library_call_while_pending
description: Calls a library function repeatedly while a check routine reports a non-zero value, running a helper after each call. It stops when the check returns zero.

name: call_library_if_check_passes
description: Runs a check routine and, only if it returns non-zero, calls one library function.

name: search_word_table_for_key
description: Scans a table of 16-bit entries terminated by minus one, using a helper to find each entry's length and skip past it, until an entry equals the supplied word.

name: measure_null_terminated_string
description: Counts the characters of a zero-terminated string and returns the count.

name: wait_for_blitter_then_spin
description: Polls the DMA control register until the blitter busy bit clears, stores a handler address into a structure, and then enters an endless loop. Blitter, DMA and interrupt registers are written here.

name: set_global_to_constant_64
description: Stores the constant 64 into a global variable and returns. The interrupt request register is listed among the touched hardware registers.

name: run_library_setup_once
description: Uses a global flag so that its library work runs once: it calls a library function and, depending on the result, calls a second function or stores a flag from a status code of 205.

name: match_text_and_read_digit
description: Compares an input string against a fixed reference text and, on a full match, checks whether the next character is a decimal digit. It stores the outcome in a global variable and returns its first argument.

name: set_flag_if_field_zero
description: Stores minus one in a global variable when a field of the structure it references is zero, and zero otherwise.

name: wait_and_get_port_message
description: Waits on a message port and then takes the next message from it. If the message field is non-zero it calls one further library function.

name: reply_message_under_forbid
description: If a stored message pointer is set, it calls the Forbid library function, replies to that message, and clears the pointer.

name: open_library_and_read_field
description: Opens an Amiga library by calling the OpenLibrary vector, repeats that call twice more, and copies a 16-bit field from the resulting library base.

name: close_library_if_open
description: Calls the CloseLibrary vector on the stored library base up to three times, each call guarded by a check that the base is non-zero.

name: set_flag_from_library_result
description: Calls a library function and stores minus one in a global variable when it returns non-zero, and zero otherwise.

name: call_library_210_if_set
description: Calls one Amiga library function through a jump vector at offset minus 210, but only when a flag global is non-zero.

name: initialize_library_resources
description: When a global is clear, calls a series of library functions to set up and open resources, stores a structure field into the global, and finishes with a further library call.

name: release_entry_and_clear_state
description: When a global is active, stores it into a structure field, looks up an entry through a library function, and clears the global if the entry's flag bits are zero. It then calls two more library functions.

name: store_current_task_pointer
description: Calls the exec FindTask function and stores its result, the current task, in a global variable.

name: store_adjusted_char_then_call
description: If a flag global is clear, stores the character at the input pointer plus 64 into a fixed RAM byte and calls a helper. Otherwise it calls a different helper.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies a zero-terminated string byte by byte from the source pointer to the destination pointer, including the terminator.

name: set_flag_if_field_below_limit
description: Sets a global variable to minus one when a 16-bit field of the referenced structure, reduced by 36, is negative, and to zero otherwise.

name: open_device_transfer_and_close
description: Allocates a signal, opens a device, performs an I/O request, then closes the device and frees the signal. It also calls two library functions and two helpers along the way.

name: release_library_if_active
description: If a global variable is non-zero, calls one library function and then clears the global.

name: probe_with_saved_field
description: Saves a structure field, sets it to minus one, and calls a library function to probe. It restores the field and then calls two further library functions, depending on the probe result.

name: call_library_vector_348
description: Calls one Amiga library function through a jump vector at offset minus 348 and returns with no result.

name: retry_library_call_with_mode
description: Calls a library function and, if it fails, retries it with a fixed mode constant, then calls two more library functions depending on the outcome.

name: finish_library_call_with_mode
description: When a global is active, sets the same fixed mode constant and calls a library function. If that succeeds it calls two further library functions and clears the global.

name: run_in_supervisor_mode
description: Sets a global from a bit in a structure field and calls the exec Supervisor function with the result.

name: store_vector_base_register
description: Stores the processor vector base register into a global variable, or zero when a flag global is clear.

name: call_helper_into_global
description: Single-instruction entry that calls one helper and copies its register result into a global variable.

name: run_install_options_dialog
description: Shows installer prompts that let the user choose playing from floppy disk or from hard disk, or leave the installation program. A message about not having enough memory appears among the referenced text.

name: write_installer_script_lines
description: Writes a list of script lines through repeated helper calls. The referenced text names the installer commands Copy, Format, Install, More and Run under the AM2_C prefix.

name: install_game_files_to_destination
description: Builds destination paths and copies the game's program, icon, keymap and document files into a chosen directory, then shows an installation message. The referenced text names the files it installs.

name: call_helper_with_local_buffer
description: Calls a helper with a ten-byte local buffer and the constant 1, then returns. It is called by three other routines.

name: copy_bounded_string_to_buffer
description: Gets a string into a 100-byte local buffer and copies it out. If it fits the given limit the whole string is copied, otherwise only the limit is copied and the destination is zero-terminated.

name: store_table_entry_and_call
description: Stores a value from a table indexed by the input register into a global variable, then calls two helpers with fields from a structure, the second receiving the global's address and the constant 1.

name: run_dos_copy_command
description: Builds a DOS Copy command line from two file names and runs it through the Execute wrapper. If execution fails it reports that the Copy command could not run and waits a short delay.

name: prompt_yes_or_no_answer
description: Repeats a prompt, reads one character, and stops when the character is Y or N, returning that character.

name: create_directory_and_unlock
description: Creates a directory through the DOS wrapper and, if a lock is returned, releases that lock with the UnLock wrapper.

name: create_save_game_directories
description: Creates the save-game directories by building numbered directory names and calling the create-directory and unlock wrappers, looping over eleven entries. The referenced text says the save-game directories are being created.

name: create_save_file
description: Allocates a buffer, builds a file name, and calls helpers to create the saves file. The referenced text says the saves file is being created.

name: read_file_size_via_lock
description: Locks a named file, examines it into a 260-byte info block, and returns the size field from that block when the examine succeeds. It unlocks the file and frees the info block afterward.

name: report_file_operation_error
description: Shows a message for a file error, choosing between couldn't be opened, couldn't be read, couldn't be written, wasn't found, and not enough memory, and then asks the user to press RETURN.

name: check_install_folder_exists
description: Locks the installer's named folder and, depending on whether the lock succeeds or reports not-found, sets a global flag. It unlocks the lock afterward.

name: set_flag_if_field_above_limit
description: Sets a global to one when a 16-bit field of the referenced structure is above 35, and to zero otherwise.

name: test_file_lock_available
description: Takes a read lock on a named file and releases it if the lock is obtained, returning whether the lock succeeded.

name: walk_parent_directories
description: Walks upward from the current directory, repeatedly examining each level through a parent-directory call, until the loop finishes.

name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies bytes from the source string into the destination until a zero byte, including the terminator, and returns the original destination pointer.

name: measure_string_length
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte string to its terminating zero and returns the number of bytes before it.

name: convert_lowercase_to_uppercase
description: Converts a single lowercase letter to uppercase and leaves every other byte unchanged.

name: convert_uppercase_to_lowercase
description: Converts a single uppercase letter to lowercase and leaves every other byte unchanged.

name: reset_global_and_call_helper
description: Clears a global variable and calls a helper with an argument taken from the caller's stack.

name: resolve_global_source
description: With a zero argument it sets the global either from a helper result or to minus one when a flag bit is set. With a non-zero argument it calls a helper with the global and a fixed address.

name: scan_formatted_string
description: Scans a string against format characters and stores each converted value through the pointer arguments, using a 130-byte local buffer. It returns the outcome of the scan.

name: poll_handler_until_ready
description: Calls a function pointer stored in a global with argument zero while a status bit is set, then calls it with argument one and returns minus one if that result is minus one, otherwise zero.

name: parse_signed_number_from_stream
description: Reads an optional plus or minus sign and then digits through a character-reading function pointer, combining them into a number and storing the result through the last pointer argument.

name: read_next_nonzero_token
description: Reads values through a helper until one is not zero, returning minus one at the end of input. When the value equals four it decrements a counter, sets a flag bit, and returns minus one.

name: read_next_buffered_byte
description: Returns the next byte from a buffer while the read position is below its limit, advancing the position. Otherwise it asks a refill helper for the value.

name: fill_and_read_stream_byte
description: Clears a pending flag, refills the stream buffer through a helper when its pointer is empty, and then reads characters through a loop that calls another helper for each one.

name: push_back_char_to_buffer
description: Writes a character back into a buffer by decrementing its position, and returns minus one when the character is invalid or the buffer is already at its start.

name: find_character_in_string
description: Returns a pointer to the first occurrence of a given character in a zero-terminated string, or zero when the character is not present.

name: validate_handle_and_read
description: Checks a file-handle index against a table and sets a status code when the handle is missing or not readable. Otherwise it performs a read through the DOS wrapper and returns the count. The file references dos.library and calls exec.Alert and exec.OldOpenLibrary.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use.

name: allocate_stream_state_structure
description: Allocates a state structure sized by six times a global value, sets two of its fields to one, and fills in the current directory and input handles through library wrappers. It returns early if the allocation fails.

name: process_command_buffer
description: Processes a command buffer by walking it through a pointer table and calling helpers for each element. The decompiled body is large, so only this overall structure is evident.

name: append_string_with_limit
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most 32766 characters.

name: append_string_limited
description: Finds the terminator of the destination string, then copies bytes from the source into it for up to the given count, stopping at a zero byte and inserting a terminator.

name: copy_string_padded_to_count
description: Copies up to the given count of bytes from the source to the destination, stopping at a zero byte, and fills the rest of the count with zero bytes. It returns the destination pointer.

name: open_icon_library_window
description: Opens the icon library and a window through the Open wrapper and related calls. The referenced text is WINDOW and icon.library.

name: store_pointer_and_call_helper
description: Saves a pointer argument into a global variable, calls a helper with the second argument and a stack-passed value, then clears the byte at the saved pointer and returns the helper's result.

name: store_pointer_and_call_helper
description: Saves a pointer argument into a global variable, calls a helper with the second argument and a stack-passed value, then clears the byte at the saved pointer and returns the helper's result.

name: store_byte_and_advance_pointer
description: Writes a byte to the location the global pointer refers to, advances that pointer by one, and returns the byte.

name: forward_to_helper_with_stack_arg
description: Calls a helper with its argument and a stack-passed value, then returns. It is called by eight other routines.

name: format_number_into_buffer
description: Converts an integer into characters in a buffer, choosing the sign and digits according to a width argument and the value's sign. It is called from two routines.

name: format_output_string
description: Formats a string from a format string and a list of arguments into a 187-byte local buffer, handling width and sign, and calls two helpers to do so.

name: divide_signed_with_sign_fix
description: Works out the sign of the result from both inputs, calls a division helper, negates that result when the signs differ, and returns it combined with the second input.

name: call_keeping_low_register
description: Calls another routine and returns a 64-bit pair whose high word is the call's second result and whose low word is the caller's original second value.

name: recurse_without_work
description: Calls itself through the same routine and then returns, performing no other work.

name: divide_32_bit_with_remainder
description: Computes the quotient and remainder of a 32-bit integer division from two register inputs. Large divisors use a bit-shifting loop, while smaller ones use standard modulo arithmetic.

name: call_helper_with_fixed_address
description: Calls a helper with its argument and a fixed address constant, then returns.

name: handle_newline_flush
description: Forwards a character to a helper and, when that character is the line-feed value ten and a flag bit is set, calls a second helper with minus one.

name: put_char_into_buffer
description: Stores a character in a bounded buffer while space remains, advancing the position and returning the byte. When the buffer is full it passes the character to a helper.

name: reset_entry_table
description: Walks a table of 22-byte entries from a fixed start up to the end marker, calling a helper on each entry.

name: close_stream_entry
description: Returns minus one for a null structure. Otherwise it flushes the stream through a helper when a flag is set, and then returns the helper's result.

name: combine_stream_flags
description: Combines the results of several helper calls, flushing when a flag is set, into a single combined status value.

name: write_buffered_stream_data
description: Writes data to a stream structure through helpers, returning minus one when the stream's error bit is set and otherwise using its buffer and position fields.

name: allocate_free_table_entry
description: Scans a table of 22-byte entries for one whose in-use byte is zero, clears its fields and returns it, or returns zero when no entry is free.

name: find_and_clear_free_entry
description: Variant of the free-entry search that clears the first unused entry it finds and returns it, returning zero when none is free.

name: clear_entry_fields
description: Zeroes the first three 32-bit fields of the entry pointed to by the address register, then returns.

name: init_buffer_with_fallback
description: Allocates a 1024-byte buffer and records it in the structure. If allocation fails it falls back to a small built-in buffer and marks the structure accordingly.

name: free_linked_entry_list
description: Walks a linked list of entries, releasing each one through a helper with its size plus eight, then clears the list head and returns zero.

name: release_entry_chain
description: Releases each entry in a linked chain by calling a helper with its address and size plus eight, then clears the chain head and returns zero.

name: push_entry_onto_list
description: Allocates an entry for the given structure and links it onto the head of a list. It returns the new entry, or zero when allocation fails.

name: forward_argument_to_helper
description: Calls one helper with its argument and returns. It is a thin wrapper.

name: find_list_entry_for_block
description: Walks a linked list looking for the entry whose block address matches the argument minus eight, returning minus one when no entry matches.

name: unlink_list_entry
description: Removes a matching entry from a linked list by updating either the list head or the previous entry's next pointer, then calls a helper.

name: unlink_entry_from_list
description: Unlinks the entry by setting either the list head or the previous entry's link to its successor, then calls a helper and returns zero.

name: set_list_head_to_next
description: Sets the list head to the next pointer of the given entry, calls a helper, and returns zero.

name: check_stream_interactive
description: Looks up a stream handle in a table and, if it is valid, calls IsInteractive through the DOS wrapper. An invalid handle sets a status of 2 and returns minus one.

name: delete_file_record_error
description: Deletes a named file through the DOS wrapper. On failure it stores the DOS error code in a global variable and returns minus one, otherwise it returns zero.

name: stub_return_zero_constant
description: Routine that only returns the constant zero, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use.

name: write_to_handle_table_entry
description: Validates a handle index against a table and writes data through the DOS write wrapper when the handle is valid. Invalid or unusable handles set a status of 2 and return minus one, and a DOS error code is used on failure.

name: check_flag_mask_then_return
description: Calls a helper with a mask of 4096 and returns its value only when that bit is set and the global is zero. Otherwise it returns zero, calling a helper first when the global is non-zero.

name: write_four_bytes_to_output
description: Writes four bytes from the global variable to the standard output handle through library wrappers, then calls one helper with the constant one.

name: run_optional_hook_then_helper
description: Calls a function pointer held in a global variable if it is set, then calls a helper with its argument.

name: release_locks_and_run_hook
description: Calls a helper for each index below a global count, then calls the UnLock wrapper and a library function, and runs a stored function pointer if one is set. The file lists exec.Supervisor among its library calls.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use.

name: close_handle_table_entry
description: Looks up a file-handle table entry and closes it through the DOS Close wrapper when it is valid. Invalid handles set a status of 2 and return minus one.

name: compute_partial_product_high_word
description: Combines 16-bit partial products of two register operands into a high word, and returns it together with the second operand unchanged as the low word.

name: call_dos_close_through_global
description: Calls the DOS Close wrapper through a jump vector at a negative offset from a global base. The jump table could not be recovered, so the indirect jump is treated as a call that takes no arguments.

name: call_dos_current_dir_through_global
description: Calls the DOS CurrentDir wrapper through a jump vector at a negative offset from a global base. The jump table could not be recovered, so the indirect jump is treated as a call.

name: call_dos_delete_file_through_global
description: Calls the DOS DeleteFile wrapper through a jump vector at a negative offset from a global base. The jump table could not be recovered, so the indirect jump is treated as a call.

name: call_dos_io_err_through_global
description: Calls the DOS IoErr wrapper through a jump vector at a negative offset from a global base. The jump table could not be recovered, so the indirect jump is treated as a call.

name: call_dos_open_through_global
description: Calls the DOS Open wrapper through a jump vector at a negative offset from a global base. The jump table could not be recovered, so the indirect jump is treated as a call.

name: call_dos_read_through_global
description: Calls the DOS Read wrapper through a jump vector at a negative offset from a global base. The jump table could not be recovered, so the indirect jump is treated as a call.

name: call_dos_write_through_global
description: Calls the DOS Write wrapper through a jump vector at a negative offset from a global base. The jump table could not be recovered, so the indirect jump is treated as a call.

name: call_library_jump_vector_414
description: Calls one Amiga library function through a jump vector at offset minus 414 from a global base. The jump table could not be recovered, so the indirect jump is treated as a call.

name: call_library_jump_vector_414
description: Calls one Amiga library function through a jump vector at offset minus 414 from a global base. The jump table could not be recovered, so the indirect jump is treated as a call.

name: call_library_jump_vector_198
description: Calls one Amiga library function through a jump vector at offset minus 198 from a global base. The jump table could not be recovered, so the indirect jump is treated as a call.

name: call_library_jump_vector_198
description: Calls one Amiga library function through a jump vector at offset minus 198 from a global base. The jump table could not be recovered, so the indirect jump is treated as a call that takes no arguments and returns nothing.

name: call_library_jump_vector_294
description: Calls one Amiga library function through a jump vector at offset minus 294 from a global base. The jump table could not be recovered, so the indirect jump is treated as a call that takes no arguments and returns nothing.

name: call_library_jump_vector_294
description: Calls one Amiga library function through a jump vector at offset minus 294 from a global base. The jump table could not be recovered, so the indirect jump is treated as a call that takes no arguments and returns nothing.

name: call_library_jump_vector_132
